integrity: The written proof uses published complete presentations plus an explicit minimal-distance lower-bound argument; standalone code verifies all presentation identities and finite critical fibers without third-party dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary catenary degree only, for four consecutive tetrahedral generators starting at n>=4. The complete minimal-presentation theorem is from Robles-Perez and Rosales (2017); numerical verification is finite (4<=n<=33) and independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Earlier implicit coverage through general methods remains a priority risk.
title: A six-class catenary degree law for consecutive tetrahedral numerical semigroups
